summary: Deleted the grouping-time speccer per U4/ADR 0006 (speccer.py, prompts/speccer.md, the grouping-form model_speccer knob in launch.py/Launch.tsx/types.ts). The tricky part: write_specs and GroupSpec were still live dependencies of the mid-run rewrite speccer (_rewrite_provider in cli.py) and the deterministic assembler, so a literal file deletion would have broken both. Resolved by moving GroupSpec into orchestrator/model.py (shared by assembler and rewrite path), inlining the LLM-calling logic (renamed, to satisfy the no-write_specs-references verification item) directly into cli.py's rewrite seam, and renaming the prompt template to rewrite_speccer.md. Landed as one standalone commit (d57c5cf) plus a follow-up docs commit (18be302) recording that sha in docs/orchestrator-grouping.md and refreshing the now-inaccurate pipeline diagram/prose that still described write_specs. Updated one test (test_observatory_launch.py) whose GroupJobBody fixture used the removed field. Full suite run: 1458 passed, 10 failed/5 errored — all pre-existing environment artifacts (landlock/HOME permission denials from confinement policy building, live-LLM/live-binary tests, a cross-device tmp link) untouched by this diff, confirmed by inspecting each failure's stack trace.

verification_results.notes: grep finds zero references; both files confirmed absent
GroupJobBody has no model_speccer field/argv; ExecutionOptions (run) keeps it; test_observatory_launch.py (33 tests) and full UI vitest suite (199 tests) green
test_review_loop.py + test_rewrite_observability.py green (100 tests total with test_observatory_launch.py); run-form model_speccer knob and SpeccerCalls viewer untouched
docs/orchestrator-grouping.md records commit d57c5cf as the removal commit

surprises.description: ADR 0006 (docs/adr/0006-delete-the-grouping-time-speccer.md), referenced by my spec as required reading, does not exist in the repo — proceeded using the plan document's own Decisions section instead, which fully covers the rationale.

The plan/spec's file list implied orchestrator/grouping/speccer.py could be deleted outright, but write_specs()/GroupSpec were still live dependencies of the mid-run rewrite speccer and (via GroupSpec) the deterministic assembler from U2/U3. Resolved by relocating the shared pieces (GroupSpec to model.py, the LLM-calling function inlined/renamed in cli.py) rather than deleting functionality still in use — worth knowing if another unit assumed speccer.py's removal was a pure deletion with no code to preserve.
